## Biography

The Mk II Sensor is an enhanced close-range signal detection module fitted to Faulcon DeLacy's Nomad ship-launched exploration vessel. It complements the Mk II Biological Scanner by helping pilots identify biological surface signals at close range. During the July 3312 Sanguineous Rim initiative, the module was praised for improving the productivity of explorer and exobiologist journeys.
